bns:Component.name: Send_TransactionLog_UpdateStatus_V2
bns:Component.bns:description: WORKAROUND (2026-11-03): this runs an UPDATE through a Standard Insert operation because the connector rejects programmatically-built Update operations (UnsupportedOperationException: This operation type is not supported:null). Parameters are bound by column name, so the request JSON keys must be STATUS and TRANSACTION_ID (upper case). | Database V2 Standard Update for Sub_TransactionLog_Consumer - the EDV_INTEGRATION.TRANSACTION_LOG row already exists (inserted synchronously by Sub_Generate_CorrelationId); this closes it out (SQL Server): sets final STATUS, END_DATE=now, and computes DURATION_MS server-side from the row's own START_DATE via DATEDIFF, so Boomi never needs to do date math itself. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57

field.value: UPDATE EDV_INTEGRATION.TRANSACTION_LOG SET STATUS = ?, END_DATE = SYSUTCDATETIME(), DURATION_MS = DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, START_DATE, SYSUTCDATETIME()) WHERE TRANSACTION_ID = ?
